cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got dinner under control. Your brother can stay; I'll give him my pie and keep everyone happy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No trouble. I'll have the peas. Seat him wherever you like; I'll manage with the vegetable portion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It'll be forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. You choose the toppings; I'll keep dinner moving while we wait. Everyone eat now, please. I can describe my substantial breakfast if anyone worries about my empty plate.
